summary: 55-year-old man had a bicycle accident on Leland Creek trail; GCSAR and Mountain Medical Response Team hiked in with a litter and brought him out to an ambulance.
notes: First of two 2020-07-04 missions described in the same post; call came in 9:47am. Wearing a helmet; injuries not life-threatening. Litter carry-out with Grand County EMS - Mountain Medical Response Team; transferred to ambulance 10:45am. Distinct from the same-day Yankee Doodle trail hiking injury.
